gloss: arts and sciences; learning and the arts

definitions.gloss: arts and sciences; learning and the arts
definitions.explanation: The combination of academic learning and creative arts, or scholarly and artistic pursuits in general.

examples.japanese: {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to the museum curator's explanation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (learning/scholarship) and ⟦{芸|げい}→芸：19343_gei⟧ (art/skill). Most commonly encountered in compound words rather than on its own. The two most frequent uses are {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん} (museum curator — an official certification in Japan) and {学芸|がくげい}{会|かい} (school arts/performance festival).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学芸|がくげい}{員|いん}: museum curator/curator
- {学芸|がくげい}{会|かい}: school arts festival/performance day
- {学芸|がくげい}{大学|だいがく}: university of arts and sciences (e.g., {東京|とうきょう}{学芸|がくげい}{大学|だいがく})
- {学芸|がくげい}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of arts and sciences

CULTURAL NOTE:
{学芸|がくげい}{会|かい} is a major event at Japanese schools where students put on plays, musical performances, and other presentations. It is distinct from ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports day) and ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧ (culture festival).
